title: Prove optimal edge-priced dirty-output fanout
body:
PR3063's destination-only ADD prices leave source-dependent routing unpriced. This package proves the exact completed-work optimum for the same single-common-value, arbitrary-dirty XOR interface with stationary positive directed tariffs: minimize `sum_root mu_i + 2 sum_edge c_ij` over directed rooted spanning forests, plus independent private-call costs. The lower bound permits arbitrary interleavings and multiplicities; a child-first preparation and literal reverse attain it without extra helpers.

The proof extends the dirt invariant to every oracle-free subset, then applies Edmonds' prescribed-root disjoint-branching theorem. A three-row chain costs 5 under declared complete prices, versus 103 for the best height-one forest and 201 for direct calls. A cheap-cycle control detects the false saving from ignoring root reachability. These are abstract complete tariffs; a physical caller, source/frame/routing/storage invoice, both supplier moments and any new kappa remain open.

Only `research/dirty-anchor-edge-tariffs/` is added. Scientific base: `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, priority revision 6. The scoped investigation is [Discussion3061](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3061#discussioncomment-18987651). Credit Ross Richardson/PR3063, Cinna Davis/PR1944, PR1968, Anthony/PR774, Oscar Fennell/PR759 and their retained synthesis lineage; Edmonds/Joo supply the external graph theorem. No priority for forest synthesis or graph optimization is claimed. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Validation passed locally on CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -I -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/dirty-anchor-edge-tariffs
```

The registered normal/optimized primary checks retain all partial cut controls and cover 18,248 rooted forests through q=6, 560 structured words through q=112, 46,372 eligible subset-cut cases and semantic/pricing defects. The separate checker constructs complete affine-state graphs through q=3 and matches all 530 unrestricted shortest-path optima to forest enumeration; 460 cases beat direct calls and 192 require mixed roots. Finite checks corroborate a written all-parameter proof using the external branching theorem; no formal-kernel or independent-human verification is claimed. Hosted CI is unverified at submission.
